scope: Primary literature and author artifacts only; no DZMM interaction or extraction experiment executed by this research agent.

core_works.title: Effective Prompt Extraction from Language Models
supports: Text-only extraction candidates can be cross-checked for consistency.
A learned DeBERTa confidence scorer is trained on 16000 known-truth extractions.
Exact sentence containment and ROUGE-L recall metrics require the original prompt.
The authors explicitly acknowledge that correctness generally cannot be verified for production systems with unknown prompts.
core_works.applicability: Text-only interface compatible; confidence needs recalibration for Chinese roleplay and cannot prove completeness without true input.
core_works.access_note: OpenReview page/PDF returned browser verification; read author arXiv HTML and GitHub instead. No challenge bypass attempted.

core_works.title: Extracting Prompts by Inverting LLM Outputs
sections_checked: Paper introduction via indexed primary PDF
supports: Learned text-only inversion without logits or adversarial queries.
Sparse encoder handles multiple output samples.
Official example asks four questions yielding sixteen items each, totaling sixty-four output items; this is not necessarily sixty-four API calls.
Author repository offers model and dataset downloads.
core_works.applicability: Potential offline surrogate-prompt generation; requires trained inverter artifacts and domain-transfer validation.
core_works.access_note: ACL metadata and GitHub opened; full PDF open returned internal error after search supplied primary PDF excerpt.

core_works.title: AdaptPrint: Response-Adaptive Fingerprinting of Black-Box LLM Services
supports: Uses domain-relevant queries and direct, continuation, and follow-up response consistency.
Reports Top-1 80.6%, Top-3 90.3%, Top-5 92.1% among 27 candidates over 18 prompt configurations.
Supports none-of-all rejection based on Top-1 minus Top-2 score margin.
Separately evaluates target-present and target-absent candidate pools.
core_works.applicability: Candidate ranking after collecting real target outputs and obtaining reference-model access; abstention and local calibration essential.
limitations: Preprint findings are not independently replicated here.
No guarantee target model is in reference pool.
Model mixture, specialization, and post-processing may invalidate stable-model assumptions.

core_works.title: Better Language Model Inversion by Compactly Representing Next-Token Distributions
sections_checked: 3 Language Model Inversion from Compressed logprobs
supports: Compresses logprob vectors across multiple generation steps before trained inversion.
Assumes access to a fixed set of token log probabilities per generation step.
Evaluation includes exact match, BLEU, and token F1 against known prompt truth.
core_works.applicability: Not currently applicable to DZMM because no target logprobs or equivalent controls have been observed.

supplementary_sources.title: LLMmap: Fingerprinting for Large Language Models
supplementary_sources.verified_claim: Author conference abstract reports 42 models, as few as eight interactions, over 95% accuracy under its evaluated setup.
supplementary_sources.caveat: Accuracy does not transfer as a guarantee to an unseen deployment and candidate pool.

supplementary_sources.title: Understanding and Mitigating Prompt Leaking Attacks in Real-World LLM-Based Applications / AREA / LeakBench
supplementary_sources.verified_claim: Author README describes 50 system prompts, model-specific adversarial queries, benign functionality-preserving queries, and AREA soft-prompt defense artifacts.
supplementary_sources.caveat: README labels the paper ACM CCS 2026; publication proceedings not independently verified in this subtask.

supplementary_sources.title: Prompt Stealing Attacks Against Text-to-Image Generation Models
supplementary_sources.decision: Excluded as direct evidence for text-only system prompt recovery because PromptStealer targets generated images.

unverified_names.name: SPEX
unverified_names.result: Exact-name searches did not locate a reliable primary paper on text-only system prompt extraction in this subtask; no claim of nonexistence.
